'''Maury''' (Japanese: '''カツミ''' ''Katsumi'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]''.

==In the movies==
[[File:Kai vs Maury.png|thumb|left|300px|Battling Kai]]
He, along with {{OBP|Kai|M10}} and [[Allegra]], challenged {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to a {{pkmn|battle}}. He went up against Ash using his {{p|Torterra}}, while Ash used his {{AP|Pikachu}}, who made a folly by commanding a {{m|Thunderbolt}} on Maury's Torterra—likely not realizing it is {{2t|Grass|Ground}}—and then switched to {{m|Iron Tail}}.

Maury was later invited by [[Baron Alberto]] to help fight off {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}.

During the ending credits, Maury participated in the [[Alamos Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]], where he was subsequently defeated by Kai in the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]]. He is not onstage when Allegra receives her winning [[Ribbon]].

Maury made a cameo appearance in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a continuity separate from {{aniseries|PTS}}. He was seen with his Torterra in Alamos Town.

==Trivia==
* Maury, {{OBP|Kai|M10}}, and [[Allegra]] each own the final form of one [[Sinnoh first partner Pokémon]].
* Though he was not referred to by name in the dub, [[Pokémon.com]] has since revealed that his name is Maury.
* Maury's character design resembles that of Torterra's color scheme.
* Maury was referred to as '''Maurice''' on his voice actor's résumé.
